purpose.zh: 坐着放松髋部外后侧，让大腿往里转得更多
purpose.en: Ease the outer back of your hip while seated so your thigh can turn inward further.

text.zh: 脚踩稳，膝盖慢慢往里倒向地面
text.en: Keep the foot planted and let the knee drop slowly in toward the floor

text.zh: 坐地手撑在身后，手臂伸直，双脚分宽。
text.en: Sit leaning back on straight arms with your feet wide.

text.zh: 停一下回来，再换另一侧。
text.en: Pause, come back up, then switch sides.

commonErrors.en: Letting the body turn with the knee.

cautions.zh: 膝盖或髋部疼时倒小一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your knee or hip hurts, drop less far, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 动画右膝、左膝轮流 → rep_alternate，unilateral 改 true（先右），剂量为每侧 6 次
英文名 Internal-Rotation 是术语，改 Seated Lean-Back Knee Drop
口令「膝盖内倒」→「往里倒」，「回到中间」→「回来」
flags: unilateral 由 false 改 true（为左右轮流计数），请确认
